title: Elderly Couple at Lake Park, 1940s Sepia Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A sepia-toned snapshot capturing an affectionate elderly couple posing under a large leaning tree outdoors. The man wears trousers supported by suspenders and holds a fedora hat at his side, while the woman wears a printed patterned dress and necklace. A wooden picnic table and a sunlit body of water are visible in the background, evoking peaceful leisure time in mid-century rural America.
